The GSE96058 cohort represents primary breast tumors with no explicit indication of neoadjuvant therapy, supporting analysis of intrinsic tumor biology rather than treatment-induced transcriptional changes.
#GSE96058 is suitable for studying intrinsic ferroptosis biology, not therapy response

This chunk takes long time 
```{r Chunk 04 — Build expression matrix + collapse duplicated gene symbols}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 04 — Build expression matrix + collapse duplicated gene symbols
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

stopifnot(exists("expr_dt"))
stopifnot(exists("clin_dt"))

data.table::setDT(expr_dt)

gene_col <- names(expr_dt)[1]
data.table::setnames(expr_dt, gene_col, "SYMBOL")

expr_dt[, SYMBOL := toupper(trimws(as.character(SYMBOL)))]
expr_dt <- expr_dt[!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != ""]

sample_cols <- grep("^F\\d+$|^GSM\\d+", names(expr_dt), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(sample_cols) > 100)

non_num <- sample_cols[!vapply(expr_dt[, ..sample_cols], is.numeric, logical(1))]
if (length(non_num) > 0) {
  message("Converting ", length(non_num), " sample columns to numeric.")
  expr_dt[, (sample_cols) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = sample_cols]
}

USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE <- TRUE

collapse_fun <- if (USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE) {
  function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

collapse_label <- ifelse(USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE, "median", "mean")

expr_dt_collapsed <- expr_dt[
  ,
  lapply(.SD, collapse_fun),
  by = SYMBOL,
  .SDcols = sample_cols
]

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_dt_collapsed[, ..sample_cols])
rownames(expr_mat) <- expr_dt_collapsed$SYMBOL

storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

qc_expr_build <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset              = project$dataset,
  n_rows_raw_expr       = nrow(expr_dt),
  n_unique_genes        = nrow(expr_mat),
  n_samples             = ncol(expr_mat),
  duplicated_gene_rows  = nrow(expr_dt) - nrow(expr_mat),
  collapse_method       = collapse_label,
  pct_missing_values    = mean(is.na(expr_mat)) * 100
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_expr_build,
  file.path(paths$tables, "04_qc_expression_matrix_build.csv")
)

saveRDS(expr_mat, file.path(paths$processed, "04_expr_mat_gene_by_sample.rds"))
saveRDS(clin_dt,  file.path(paths$processed, "04_clin_raw.rds"))

message("Expression matrix built: ", nrow(expr_mat), " genes x ", ncol(expr_mat), " samples")
qc_expr_build

```

```{r Chunk 05 — Map expression columns to sample IDs}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 05 — Map expression columns to sample IDs
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "04_expr_mat_gene_by_sample.rds"))
clin_dt  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "04_clin_raw.rds")) |> as.data.frame()

message("Expression matrix: ", nrow(expr_mat), " genes x ", ncol(expr_mat), " samples")
message("Clinical table: ", nrow(clin_dt), " rows x ", ncol(clin_dt), " columns")

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) > 100)
stopifnot(nrow(clin_dt) > 100)

extract_gsm_from_series_matrix <- function(fp) {
  con <- if (grepl("\\.gz$", fp, ignore.case = TRUE)) gzfile(fp, "rt") else file(fp, "rt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)

  lines <- readLines(con, warn = FALSE)
  ix <- grep("^!Sample_geo_accession", lines)

  if (length(ix) != 1) return(character(0))

  tokens <- strsplit(lines[ix], "\t")[[1]]
  gsm <- tokens[-1]
  gsm <- gsub('"', "", gsm)
  gsm[!is.na(gsm) & gsm != ""]
}

expr_sample_ids_original <- colnames(expr_mat)

mapping_strategy <- NA_character_

# Case A — expression columns already GSM-named
if (all(stringr::str_detect(expr_sample_ids_original[seq_len(min(10, length(expr_sample_ids_original)))], "^GSM\\d+"))) {

  mapping_strategy <- "expression columns already GSM IDs"
  expr_mat_named <- expr_mat

# Case B — expression columns already match clinical sample_id
} else if ("sample_id" %in% names(clin_dt)) {

  clin_ids <- as.character(clin_dt$sample_id)

  overlap_direct <- sum(expr_sample_ids_original %in% clin_ids)

  if (overlap_direct >= 0.80 * min(length(expr_sample_ids_original), length(clin_ids))) {

    mapping_strategy <- "expression columns directly match clinical sample_id"
    expr_mat_named <- expr_mat

  } else if (
    sum(stringr::str_detect(clin_ids, "^GSM\\d+")) >= 100 &&
    length(clin_ids) == ncol(expr_mat) &&
    anyDuplicated(clin_ids) == 0
  ) {

    mapping_strategy <- "renamed expression columns using clinical sample_id GSM order"
    expr_mat_named <- expr_mat
    colnames(expr_mat_named) <- clin_ids

  } else {

    sm_files <- list.files(
      paths$raw,
      pattern = "series_matrix\\.txt(\\.gz)?$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    stopifnot(length(sm_files) >= 1)

    gsm_list <- lapply(sm_files, extract_gsm_from_series_matrix)
    gsm_n <- vapply(gsm_list, length, integer(1))

    for (i in seq_along(sm_files)) {
      message("Series matrix file: ", basename(sm_files[i]), " | GSM count: ", gsm_n[i])
    }

    hit <- which(gsm_n == ncol(expr_mat))

    if (length(hit) == 1) {

      mapping_strategy <- paste0("renamed expression columns using ", basename(sm_files[hit]))
      expr_mat_named <- expr_mat
      colnames(expr_mat_named) <- gsm_list[[hit]]

    } else if (sum(gsm_n) == ncol(expr_mat)) {

      gsm_all <- unlist(gsm_list)
      stopifnot(anyDuplicated(gsm_all) == 0)

      mapping_strategy <- "renamed expression columns using combined series_matrix GSM order"
      expr_mat_named <- expr_mat
      colnames(expr_mat_named) <- gsm_all

    } else {
      stop(
        "Cannot map expression columns to sample IDs. ncol(expr_mat) = ",
        ncol(expr_mat),
        " | series_matrix GSM counts = ",
        paste(gsm_n, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }

} else {
  stop("Clinical table has no sample_id column and expression columns are not GSM IDs.")
}

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat_named) == ncol(expr_mat))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(colnames(expr_mat_named)) == 0)

qc_mapping <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset              = project$dataset,
  n_expression_samples = ncol(expr_mat_named),
  n_clinical_rows      = nrow(clin_dt),
  mapping_strategy     = mapping_strategy,
  first_5_expr_ids     = paste(head(colnames(expr_mat_named), 5), collapse = "; "),
  first_5_clin_ids     = if ("sample_id" %in% names(clin_dt)) {
    paste(head(as.character(clin_dt$sample_id), 5), collapse = "; ")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_mapping,
  file.path(paths$tables, "05_qc_sample_id_mapping.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  expr_mat_named,
  file.path(paths$processed, "05_expr_mat_named.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  clin_dt,
  file.path(paths$processed, "05_clin_raw_after_mapping.rds")
)

message("Sample ID mapping strategy: ", mapping_strategy)
message("Saved: 05_expr_mat_named.rds")

qc_mapping

```
Because expression has 3,273 samples but clinical has 2,986 rows, Chunk 06 will keep only matched clinical samples and preserve expression order.

```{r Chunk 06 — Align expression and clinical samples}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
```

```{r Chunk 07 — Standardize PAM50 and receptor annotations}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 07 — Standardize PAM50 and receptor annotations
# Purpose:
#   Prepare robust subtype labels for the new design:
#   1) PAM50 multi-subtype analysis
#   2) focused ERpos vs TNBC contrast
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_expr_mat_aligned.rds"))
clin_dt  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_clin_aligned.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) == nrow(clin_dt))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == clin_dt$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# Helper 1 — receptor standardization
# ----------------------------

std_status <- function(x, field_name = "") {
  x_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

  if (any(x_raw %in% c("1", "0"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning(
      field_name,
      ": integer encoding detected. Mapping 1=Positive, 0=Negative. ",
      "Verify this is correct for this clinical file."
    )
  }

  dplyr::case_when(
    x_raw %in% c("pos", "positive", "+", "1", "yes", "y") ~ "Positive",
    x_raw %in% c("neg", "negative", "-", "0", "no", "n")  ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Helper 2 — PAM50 standardization
# ----------------------------

std_pam50 <- function(x) {
  x_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

  dplyr::case_when(
    x_raw %in% c("luminal a", "luma", "luminala", "lum_a", "lum a") ~ "LumA",
    x_raw %in% c("luminal b", "lumb", "luminalb", "lum_b", "lum b") ~ "LumB",
    x_raw %in% c("her2", "her2-enriched", "her2 enriched", "her2enriched", "her2+") ~ "HER2_enriched",
    x_raw %in% c("basal", "basal-like", "basal like", "basallike") ~ "Basal",
    x_raw %in% c("normal", "normal-like", "normal like", "normallike") ~ "Normal_like",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Detect required columns
# ----------------------------

required_cols <- c("sample_id", "pam50_subtype")
missing_required <- setdiff(required_cols, names(clin_dt))
if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required clinical columns: ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "))
}

receptor_cols <- c("ER_status", "PGR_status", "HER2_status")
missing_receptors <- setdiff(receptor_cols, names(clin_dt))

if (length(missing_receptors) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Missing receptor columns: ",
    paste(missing_receptors, collapse = ", "),
    ". Focused ERpos/TNBC contrast may be incomplete."
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Standardize annotations
# ----------------------------

clin_std <- clin_dt %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),

    ER_status_std = if ("ER_status" %in% names(.)) {
      std_status(ER_status, "ER_status")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    PGR_status_std = if ("PGR_status" %in% names(.)) {
      std_status(PGR_status, "PGR_status")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    HER2_status_std = if ("HER2_status" %in% names(.)) {
      std_status(HER2_status, "HER2_status")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    pam50_simple = std_pam50(pam50_subtype),

    pam50_simple = factor(
      pam50_simple,
      levels = c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")
    ),

    broad_receptor_group = dplyr::case_when(
      ER_status_std == "Positive" & HER2_status_std == "Negative" ~ "ERpos_HER2neg",
      ER_status_std == "Negative" & PGR_status_std == "Negative" & HER2_status_std == "Negative" ~ "TNBC",
      HER2_status_std == "Positive" ~ "HER2pos",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = dplyr::case_when(
      broad_receptor_group == "ERpos_HER2neg" ~ "ERpos",
      broad_receptor_group == "TNBC" ~ "TNBC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      focused_group_ERpos_TNBC,
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# QC tables
# ----------------------------

qc_pam50 <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

qc_receptor <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(ER_status_std, PGR_status_std, HER2_status_std, broad_receptor_group, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

qc_pam50_by_receptor <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, broad_receptor_group, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(pam50_simple, desc(n))

qc_focused <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

readr::write_csv(qc_pam50, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_pam50_subtype_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_receptor, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_receptor_group_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_pam50_by_receptor, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_pam50_by_receptor_group.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_focused, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_focused_ERpos_TNBC_counts.csv"))

saveRDS(clin_std, file.path(paths$processed, "07_clin_standardized.rds"))

message("Clinical annotations standardized.")
message("PAM50 subtype counts:")
print(qc_pam50)

message("Focused ERpos/TNBC counts:")
print(qc_focused)

clin_std %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, pam50_subtype, pam50_simple,
                ER_status_std, PGR_status_std, HER2_status_std,
                broad_receptor_group, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC) %>%
  head()

```


```{r Chunk 08 — Build analysis cohorts}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 08 — Build analysis cohorts
# Purpose:
#   1) Primary cohort: PAM50 multi-subtype analysis
#      LumA, LumB, HER2-enriched, Basal, Normal-like
#   2) Focused cohort: receptor-defined ERpos vs TNBC contrast
#   3) Concordance labels for sensitivity analyses
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_expr_mat_aligned.rds"))
clin_std <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "07_clin_standardized.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) == nrow(clin_std))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == clin_std$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 08A — Primary PAM50 multi-subtype cohort
# ----------------------------

pam50_keep <- c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")

clin_pam50 <- clin_std %>%
  filter(!is.na(pam50_simple), pam50_simple %in% pam50_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    pam50_simple = factor(
      as.character(pam50_simple),
      levels = pam50_keep
    )
  )

expr_pam50 <- expr_mat[, clin_pam50$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_pam50) == clin_pam50$sample_id))

qc_pam50_cohort <- clin_pam50 %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = "PAM50_multi_subtype_primary",
    frac = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, pam50_simple, n, frac)

# ----------------------------
# 08B — Focused receptor-defined ERpos vs TNBC cohort
# ----------------------------

clin_focused <- clin_std %>%
  filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)) %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

expr_focused <- expr_mat[, clin_focused$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

qc_focused_cohort <- clin_focused %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = "Focused_receptor_ERpos_vs_TNBC",
    frac = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, n, frac)

# ----------------------------
# 08C — Concordance labels
# These are not the primary filter yet.
# They are saved for sensitivity analysis.
# ----------------------------

clin_concordance <- clin_std %>%
  mutate(
    receptor_pam50_concordance = dplyr::case_when(
      broad_receptor_group == "ERpos_HER2neg" &
        pam50_simple %in% c("LumA", "LumB") ~ "Concordant_ERpos_Luminal",

      broad_receptor_group == "TNBC" &
        pam50_simple == "Basal" ~ "Concordant_TNBC_Basal",

      broad_receptor_group == "HER2pos" &
        pam50_simple == "HER2_enriched" ~ "Concordant_HER2pos_HER2enriched",

      is.na(broad_receptor_group) | is.na(pam50_simple) ~ "Insufficient_annotation",

      TRUE ~ "Discordant_or_mixed"
    )
  )

qc_concordance <- clin_concordance %>%
  dplyr::count(receptor_pam50_concordance, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# ----------------------------
# 08D — Save outputs
# ----------------------------
```

```{r Chunk 09 — Handle technical replicates and cohort QC}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 09 — Handle technical replicates and cohort QC
# Purpose:
#   Remove or collapse technical replicates before scoring.
#   Apply consistently to:
#     1) PAM50 primary cohort
#     2) focused ERpos/TNBC cohort
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

expr_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_PAM50_primary.rds"))
clin_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_PAM50_primary.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

expr_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds"))
clin_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_pam50) == clin_pam50$sample_id))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY <- TRUE

detect_replicates <- function(clin_tbl) {
  clin_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
      patient_id = sub("([._]?repl\\d*)$", "", sample_id, ignore.case = TRUE),
      is_repl = grepl("([._]?repl\\d*)$", sample_id, ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
}

make_repSAFE <- function(expr_mat, clin_tbl, cohort_label) {

  clin_tbl <- detect_replicates(clin_tbl)

  rep_qc <- clin_tbl %>%
    dplyr::count(is_repl, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(cohort = cohort_label, KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY = KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY) %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY, is_repl, n)

  if (KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY) {

    keep <- which(!clin_tbl$is_repl)

    expr_out <- expr_mat[, clin_tbl$sample_id[keep], drop = FALSE]
    clin_out <- clin_tbl[keep, , drop = FALSE]

    note <- paste0(
      cohort_label,
      ": KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY=TRUE | kept ",
      ncol(expr_out),
      " samples | dropped ",
      sum(clin_tbl$is_repl),
      " technical replicates."
    )

  } else {

    uniq_pid <- unique(clin_tbl$patient_id)

    expr_out <- sapply(uniq_pid, function(id) {
      cols <- clin_tbl$sample_id[clin_tbl$patient_id == id]
      if (length(cols) == 1) {
        return(expr_mat[, cols])
      } else {
        return(rowMeans(expr_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
      }
    })

    expr_out <- as.matrix(expr_out)
    rownames(expr_out) <- rownames(expr_mat)
    colnames(expr_out) <- uniq_pid

    clin_out <- clin_tbl %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(sample_id = patient_id)

    note <- paste0(
      cohort_label,
      ": KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY=FALSE | collapsed to ",
      ncol(expr_out),
      " patient-level profiles."
    )
  }

  stopifnot(ncol(expr_out) == nrow(clin_out))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_out) == clin_out$sample_id))
  stopifnot(anyDuplicated(clin_out$sample_id) == 0)

  list(
    expr = expr_out,
    clin = clin_out,
    rep_qc = rep_qc,
    note = note
  )
}

pam50_repSAFE <- make_repSAFE(
  expr_mat = expr_pam50,
  clin_tbl = clin_pam50,
  cohort_label = "PAM50_primary"
)

focused_repSAFE <- make_repSAFE(
  expr_mat = expr_focused,
  clin_tbl = clin_focused,
  cohort_label = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC"
)

# ----------------------------
# QC after replicate handling
# ----------------------------

qc_pam50_repSAFE <- pam50_repSAFE$clin %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(cohort = "PAM50_primary_repSAFE", frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, pam50_simple, n, frac)

qc_focused_repSAFE <- focused_repSAFE$clin %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(cohort = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE", frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, n, frac)

qc_replicates <- bind_rows(
  pam50_repSAFE$rep_qc,
  focused_repSAFE$rep_qc
)

# ----------------------------
# Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(pam50_repSAFE$expr, file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
saveRDS(pam50_repSAFE$clin, file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))

saveRDS(focused_repSAFE$expr, file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
saveRDS(focused_repSAFE$clin, file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))

readr::write_csv(qc_replicates, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_replicate_detection.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_pam50_repSAFE, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_focused_repSAFE, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.csv"))

writeLines(
  c(
    pam50_repSAFE$note,
    focused_repSAFE$note
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$tables, "09_replicate_handling_note.txt")
)

message("PAM50 primary cohort after replicate handling:")
print(qc_pam50_repSAFE)

message("Focused ERpos/TNBC cohort after replicate handling:")
print(qc_focused_repSAFE)

message("Replicate QC:")
print(qc_replicates)
```

```{r Chunk 10 — Conservative ferroptosis axes}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 10 — Conservative ferroptosis axes
# Pipeline logic:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Principle:
#   Use conservative CORE genes for axis scoring.
#   Keep context-dependent markers only as SUPPORT genes for interpretation.
#
# Why:
#   Downstream results depend on these axes.
#   Therefore, avoid broad FerrDb-style lists that may include stress markers,
#   general NRF2 targets, inflammatory genes, or context-dependent markers.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

expr_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 10A — Conservative CORE axes for scoring
# ----------------------------
# These genes will be used for module scores.
# They are selected for clearer pathway membership and lower risk of
# misleading subtype-specific stress/inflammation effects.

ferro_axes_core <- list(

  # Cystine import and glutathione biosynthesis/recycling.
  # Do not include NFE2L2 here because it is a broad stress TF.
  Xc_GSH = c(
    "SLC7A11", "SLC3A2",
    "GCLC", "GCLM", "GSS", "GSR"
  ),

  # GPX4-centered selenium/selenoprotein machinery.
  # Use genes directly linked to GPX4 synthesis/function.
  GPX4_Selenium = c(
    "GPX4",
    "SEPHS2", "PSTK", "SEPSECS", "EEFSEC", "SECISBP2"
  ),

  # FSP1-CoQ antioxidant defense.
  # AIFM2 is FSP1. CoQ biosynthesis genes retained.
  # NQO1 excluded from core because it is broad NRF2/stress responsive.
  FSP1_CoQ = c(
    "AIFM2",
    "PDSS1", "PDSS2",
    "COQ2", "COQ6", "COQ7", "COQ9", "COQ10A", "COQ10B"
  ),

  # GCH1-BH4 antioxidant defense.
  BH4_GCH1 = c(
    "GCH1", "PTS", "SPR", "QDPR", "DHFR"
  ),

  # Mitochondrial ferroptosis defense.
  # Keep this compact to avoid non-specific mitochondrial metabolism noise.
  DHODH_Mito = c(
    "DHODH", "CISD1", "CISD2"
  ),

  # Iron handling.
  # HMOX1 excluded from core because it is highly stress/context-dependent.
  Iron_Handling = c(
    "TFRC", "SLC11A2", "STEAP3",
    "FTH1", "FTL",
    "NCOA4", "SLC40A1"
  ),

  # PUFA loading into phospholipids.
  # MBOAT1/MBOAT2 excluded from core because they represent MUFA remodeling/
  # suppressive compensation rather than canonical PUFA-loading susceptibility.
  PUFA_Loading = c(
    "ACSL4", "LPCAT3", "FADS1", "FADS2"
  ),

  # Enzymatic lipid peroxidation capacity.
  # PTGS2 excluded from core because it is a marker of ferroptosis/inflammation,
  # not a clean causal peroxidation-axis scoring gene.
  Lipid_Peroxidation = c(
    "ALOX5", "ALOX12", "ALOX15",
    "POR", "NOX1", "NOX4"
  )
)

ferro_axes_core <- lapply(
  ferro_axes_core,
  function(x) unique(toupper(trimws(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])))
)

AXES_ORDER <- names(ferro_axes_core)

# ----------------------------
# 10B — Support genes, not used for primary scoring
# ----------------------------
# These genes can be reported later as marker-level support or sensitivity,
# but they should not drive the main axis scores.

ferro_support_genes <- list(

  NRF2_Stress_Response = c(
    "NFE2L2", "KEAP1", "HMOX1", "NQO1", "TXNRD1"
  ),

  Ferroptosis_Response_Markers = c(
    "PTGS2", "CHAC1", "SAT1"
  ),

  MUFA_Remodeling_Resistance = c(
    "ACSL3", "SCD", "MBOAT1", "MBOAT2"
  ),

  Additional_NEET_Mito = c(
    "CISD3"
  ),

  Additional_Selenium_Redox = c(
    "SCLY", "PRDX6"
  )
)

ferro_support_genes <- lapply(
  ferro_support_genes,
  function(x) unique(toupper(trimws(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])))
)

# ----------------------------
# 10C — Axis membership tables
# ----------------------------

axis_gene_table_core <- tibble::tibble(
  axis = rep(names(ferro_axes_core), lengths(ferro_axes_core)),
  gene = unlist(ferro_axes_core, use.names = FALSE),
  role = "core_scoring_gene"
) %>%
  arrange(axis, gene)

axis_gene_table_support <- tibble::tibble(
  support_group = rep(names(ferro_support_genes), lengths(ferro_support_genes)),
  gene = unlist(ferro_support_genes, use.names = FALSE),
  role = "support_not_primary_scoring"
) %>%
  arrange(support_group, gene)

dup_core_genes <- axis_gene_table_core %>%
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "n_axes") %>%
  filter(n_axes > 1)

if (nrow(dup_core_genes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Core scoring genes overlap between axes: ",
    paste(dup_core_genes$gene, collapse = ", "),
    ". Fix before scoring."
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 10D — Coverage QC
# ----------------------------

available_genes <- rownames(expr_pam50)

axis_coverage_core <- axis_gene_table_core %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_GSE96058 = gene %in% available_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_defined = n(),
    n_genes_present = sum(present_in_GSE96058),
    coverage_frac = n_genes_present / n_genes_defined,
    present_genes = paste(gene[present_in_GSE96058], collapse = "; "),
    missing_genes = paste(gene[!present_in_GSE96058], collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(axis, AXES_ORDER))

support_gene_coverage <- axis_gene_table_support %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_GSE96058 = gene %in% available_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(support_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_defined = n(),
    n_genes_present = sum(present_in_GSE96058),
    coverage_frac = n_genes_present / n_genes_defined,
    present_genes = paste(gene[present_in_GSE96058], collapse = "; "),
    missing_genes = paste(gene[!present_in_GSE96058], collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

low_coverage_axes <- axis_coverage_core %>%
  filter(coverage_frac < SPEC$min_axis_cov)

if (nrow(low_coverage_axes) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Low-coverage CORE axes detected: ",
    paste(low_coverage_axes$axis, collapse = ", "),
    ". Review before scoring."
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 10E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(ferro_axes_core, file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds"))
saveRDS(ferro_support_genes, file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_support_genes_not_scoring.rds"))
saveRDS(AXES_ORDER, file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

readr::write_csv(
  axis_gene_table_core,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_membership.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_gene_table_support,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_SUPPORT_ferroptosis_genes_not_primary_scoring.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_coverage_core,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_coverage_GSE96058.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  support_gene_coverage,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_SUPPORT_gene_coverage_GSE96058.csv")
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "Conservative ferroptosis axis strategy",
    "",
    "Main principle:",
    "The primary analysis uses curated core pathway genes as ferroptosis axis scores.",
    "Broad stress-response genes, inflammatory markers, and context-dependent markers are excluded from primary scoring.",
    "",
    "Primary scoring axes:",
    paste0("- ", AXES_ORDER),
    "",
    "Genes excluded from primary scoring but retained as support markers:",
    "- NFE2L2, KEAP1, HMOX1, NQO1, TXNRD1: broad NRF2/stress-response context.",
    "- PTGS2, CHAC1, SAT1: response/marker genes, not clean axis activity genes.",
    "- ACSL3, SCD, MBOAT1, MBOAT2: MUFA remodeling/resistance context, not PUFA-loading core.",
    "- CISD3, SCLY, PRDX6: retained as support/sensitivity rather than core scoring genes.",
    "",
    "Interpretation rule:",
    "Axis-level scores are the primary biological evidence.",
    "Single genes are used later as marker-level support and experimental candidates.",
    "",
    "Rationale:",
    "This avoids overclaiming from unstable single markers and improves portability across GSE96058, METABRIC, and GSE25066."
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$tables, "10_conservative_axis_strategy_note.txt")
)

message("Conservative core ferroptosis axes defined: ", length(ferro_axes_core))
message("Core axis coverage:")
print(axis_coverage_core)

message("Support gene coverage:")
print(support_gene_coverage)

axis_gene_table_core

```


```{r Chunk 11 — Gene-wise Z-score matrices}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 11 — Gene-wise Z-score matrices
# Pipeline logic:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Convert expression to gene-wise Z-scores within each analysis cohort.
#   This makes genes comparable within module scores.
#
# Outputs:
#   1) PAM50 primary Z-matrix
#   2) focused ERpos/TNBC Z-matrix
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(matrixStats)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

expr_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
clin_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))

expr_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
clin_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_pam50) == clin_pam50$sample_id))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

make_gene_z <- function(expr_mat, cohort_label) {

  row_means <- rowMeans(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  row_sds   <- matrixStats::rowSds(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

  row_sds[!is.finite(row_sds) | row_sds == 0] <- NA_real_

  expr_z <- sweep(expr_mat, 1, row_means, "-")
  expr_z <- sweep(expr_z, 1, row_sds, "/")
  expr_z[!is.finite(expr_z)] <- NA_real_

  qc_z <- tibble::tibble(
    cohort = cohort_label,
    n_genes = nrow(expr_z),
    n_samples = ncol(expr_z),
    pct_missing_z = mean(is.na(expr_z)) * 100,
    n_zero_or_invalid_sd_genes = sum(is.na(row_sds)),
    median_gene_sd_raw = median(row_sds, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  list(expr_z = expr_z, qc = qc_z)
}

z_pam50 <- make_gene_z(
  expr_mat = expr_pam50,
  cohort_label = "PAM50_primary_repSAFE"
)

z_focused <- make_gene_z(
  expr_mat = expr_focused,
  cohort_label = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE"
)

saveRDS(
  z_pam50$expr_z,
  file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  z_focused$expr_z,
  file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")
)

qc_z_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(z_pam50$qc, z_focused$qc)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_z_all,
  file.path(paths$tables, "11_qc_gene_wise_zscore_matrices.csv")
)

message("Gene-wise Z-score matrices created.")
print(qc_z_all)
```

```{r Chunk 12 — Ferroptosis axis scores}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 12 — Ferroptosis axis scores
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Compute:
#     1) Weighted module scores (PRIMARY)
#     2) Unweighted mean-Z scores (SENSITIVITY)
#
# Key rule:
#   Only CORE axis genes are used for scoring.
#   Missing genes are safely ignored per sample.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
})

# Load inputs
expr_z_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
expr_z_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))

ferro_axes_core <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 12A — Weighted module score function
# ----------------------------

compute_axis_scores <- function(expr_z, axes_list, cohort_label) {

  # gene-level SD used as weights (from Z input → SD ~ 1 but NA genes excluded)
  gene_sd <- matrixStats::rowSds(expr_z, na.rm = TRUE)

  axis_scores_weighted <- list()
  axis_scores_unweighted <- list()
  axis_qc <- list()

  for (ax in names(axes_list)) {

    genes <- axes_list[[ax]]
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_z))

    if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
      warning("Axis ", ax, " has zero genes in matrix.")
      next
    }

    sub_mat <- expr_z[genes_present, , drop = FALSE]
    weights <- gene_sd[genes_present]

    # Remove genes with NA weights
    valid <- is.finite(weights) & !is.na(weights)
    sub_mat <- sub_mat[valid, , drop = FALSE]
    weights <- weights[valid]

    # Normalize weights
    weights <- weights / sum(weights)

    # Weighted score
    score_w <- colSums(sweep(sub_mat, 1, weights, "*"), na.rm = TRUE)

    # Unweighted score (mean Z)
    score_u <- colMeans(sub_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

    axis_scores_weighted[[ax]]   <- score_w
    axis_scores_unweighted[[ax]] <- score_u

    axis_qc[[ax]] <- tibble::tibble(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      axis = ax,
      n_genes_defined = length(genes),
      n_genes_used = nrow(sub_mat),
      coverage_frac = nrow(sub_mat) / length(genes)
    )
  }

  scores_w <- as.data.frame(axis_scores_weighted)
  scores_u <- as.data.frame(axis_scores_unweighted)

  scores_w$sample_id <- colnames(expr_z)
  scores_u$sample_id <- colnames(expr_z)

  scores_w <- tibble::as_tibble(scores_w)
  scores_u <- tibble::as_tibble(scores_u)

  qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(axis_qc)

  list(
    weighted = scores_w,
    unweighted = scores_u,
    qc = qc
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 12B — Compute scores
# ----------------------------

scores_pam50 <- compute_axis_scores(
  expr_z = expr_z_pam50,
  axes_list = ferro_axes_core,
  cohort_label = "PAM50_primary"
)

scores_focused <- compute_axis_scores(
  expr_z = expr_z_focused,
  axes_list = ferro_axes_core,
  cohort_label = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC"
)

# ----------------------------
# 12C — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(scores_pam50$weighted,
        file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_PAM50.rds"))

saveRDS(scores_pam50$unweighted,
        file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_PAM50.rds"))

saveRDS(scores_focused$weighted,
        file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_focused.rds"))

saveRDS(scores_focused$unweighted,
        file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_focused.rds"))

qc_axes <- dplyr::bind_rows(scores_pam50$qc, scores_focused$qc)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_axes,
  file.path(paths$tables, "12_qc_axis_gene_coverage_used.csv")
)

message("Axis scoring completed.")
print(qc_axes)

```
```{r Chunk 13 — Add clinical labels to axis scores}

# ----------------------------
# Chunk 13 — Add clinical labels to axis scores
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ----------------------------
# 13A — Load scores and clinical metadata
# ----------------------------

scores_w_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_PAM50.rds"))
scores_u_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_PAM50.rds"))

scores_w_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_focused.rds"))
scores_u_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_focused.rds"))

clin_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

clin_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

# ----------------------------
# 13A.5 — Diagnostic: detect actual axis columns in scores
# ----------------------------

axis_cols_defined <- names(readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds")))

# Identify which defined axes are actually present as columns
axis_cols_in_pam50   <- intersect(axis_cols_defined, names(scores_w_pam50))
axis_cols_in_focused <- intersect(axis_cols_defined, names(scores_w_focused))

# Use the union that appears in at least one scores object
axis_cols <- union(axis_cols_in_pam50, axis_cols_in_focused)

# Report any mismatches
missing_from_pam50   <- setdiff(axis_cols_defined, names(scores_w_pam50))
missing_from_focused <- setdiff(axis_cols_defined, names(scores_w_focused))

if (length(missing_from_pam50) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Axes defined in Chunk 10 but MISSING from PAM50 scores: ",
    paste(missing_from_pam50, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(missing_from_focused) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Axes defined in Chunk 10 but MISSING from focused scores: ",
    paste(missing_from_focused, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

message("Axis columns confirmed present in PAM50 scores:   ", paste(axis_cols_in_pam50,   collapse = ", "))
message("Axis columns confirmed present in focused scores: ", paste(axis_cols_in_focused, collapse = ", "))

stopifnot(length(axis_cols) > 0)

# ----------------------------
# 13B — Join clinical labels
# ----------------------------

meta_pam50 <- clin_pam50 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    pam50_simple,
    ER_status_std,
    PGR_status_std,
    HER2_status_std,
    broad_receptor_group,
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC
  )

meta_focused <- clin_focused %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    pam50_simple,
    ER_status_std,
    PGR_status_std,
    HER2_status_std,
    broad_receptor_group,
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC
  )

scores_w_pam50_annot <- scores_w_pam50 %>%
  left_join(meta_pam50, by = "sample_id")

scores_u_pam50_annot <- scores_u_pam50 %>%
  left_join(meta_pam50, by = "sample_id")

scores_w_focused_annot <- scores_w_focused %>%
  left_join(meta_focused, by = "sample_id")

scores_u_focused_annot <- scores_u_focused %>%
  left_join(meta_focused, by = "sample_id")

# ----------------------------
# 13C — Safety checks
# ----------------------------

stopifnot(nrow(scores_w_pam50_annot)   == nrow(clin_pam50))
stopifnot(nrow(scores_u_pam50_annot)   == nrow(clin_pam50))
stopifnot(nrow(scores_w_focused_annot) == nrow(clin_focused))
stopifnot(nrow(scores_u_focused_annot) == nrow(clin_focused))

stopifnot(!any(is.na(scores_w_pam50_annot$pam50_simple)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(scores_w_focused_annot$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)))

# ----------------------------
# 13D — Long-format versions for plotting/statistics
# Uses only axis columns confirmed present in each respective scores object
# ----------------------------

make_long_scores <- function(scores_tbl, cohort_label, score_type, group_col, defined_axes) {

  # Only pivot axes that actually exist in this scores table
  axes_to_use <- intersect(defined_axes, names(scores_tbl))

  if (length(axes_to_use) == 0) {
    stop("No axis columns found in scores table for cohort: ", cohort_label)
  }

  missing_axes <- setdiff(defined_axes, axes_to_use)
  if (length(missing_axes) > 0) {
    warning(
      "Cohort '", cohort_label, "': pivoting ", length(axes_to_use),
      " of ", length(defined_axes), " defined axes. Missing: ",
      paste(missing_axes, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  scores_tbl %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(axes_to_use),
      names_to = "axis",
      values_to = "score"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cohort     = cohort_label,
      score_type = score_type,
      axis       = factor(axis, levels = defined_axes),
      comparison_group = as.character(.data[[group_col]])
    )
}

long_w_pam50 <- make_long_scores(
  scores_w_pam50_annot,
  cohort_label  = "PAM50_primary",
  score_type    = "weighted_primary",
  group_col     = "pam50_simple",
  defined_axes  = axis_cols_defined
)

long_u_pam50 <- make_long_scores(
  scores_u_pam50_annot,
  cohort_label  = "PAM50_primary",
  score_type    = "unweighted_sensitivity",
  group_col     = "pam50_simple",
  defined_axes  = axis_cols_defined
)

long_w_focused <- make_long_scores(
  scores_w_focused_annot,
  cohort_label  = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
  score_type    = "weighted_primary",
  group_col     = "focused_group_ERpos_TNBC",
  defined_axes  = axis_cols_defined
)

long_u_focused <- make_long_scores(
  scores_u_focused_annot,
  cohort_label  = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
  score_type    = "unweighted_sensitivity",
  group_col     = "focused_group_ERpos_TNBC",
  defined_axes  = axis_cols_defined
)

scores_long_all <- bind_rows(
  long_w_pam50,
  long_u_pam50,
  long_w_focused,
  long_u_focused
)

# ----------------------------
# 13E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(scores_w_pam50_annot,   file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_PAM50_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(scores_u_pam50_annot,   file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_unweighted_PAM50_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(scores_w_focused_annot, file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(scores_u_focused_annot, file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_unweighted_focused_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(scores_long_all,        file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_long_all.rds"))

readr::write_csv(scores_long_all, file.path(paths$tables, "13_scores_long_all.csv"))

qc_scores_annot <- scores_long_all %>%
  group_by(cohort, score_type, comparison_group, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = sum(is.finite(score)),
    mean_score   = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score     = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  qc_scores_annot,
  file.path(paths$tables, "13_qc_axis_score_distributions_by_group.csv")
)

message("Clinical labels added to axis scores.")
message("Axes used: ", paste(axis_cols_defined, collapse = ", "))
print(qc_scores_annot)
```

```{r Chunk 14 — PAM50 multi-subtype axis comparison + visualization}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 14 — PAM50 multi-subtype axis comparison + visualization
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Test whether conservative ferroptosis axis activity differs across:
#   LumA, LumB, HER2_enriched, Basal, Normal_like
#
# Primary score:
#   weighted_primary
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(rstatix)
  library(patchwork)
})

scores_long_all <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_long_all.rds"))

pam50_w <- scores_long_all %>%
  filter(
    cohort == "PAM50_primary",
    score_type == "weighted_primary",
    !is.na(comparison_group),
    is.finite(score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_group = factor(
      comparison_group,
      levels = c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14A — Global Kruskal-Wallis test per axis
# ----------------------------

kw_pam50 <- pam50_w %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  rstatix::kruskal_test(score ~ comparison_group) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    significant_FDR_0.05 = FDR_BH < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR_BH)

# ----------------------------
# 14B — Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
# ----------------------------

pairwise_pam50 <- pam50_w %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(
    score ~ comparison_group,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(axis, p.adj)

# ----------------------------
# 14C — Median axis pattern table
# ----------------------------

pam50_axis_pattern <- pam50_w %>%
  group_by(axis, comparison_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  mutate(
    axis_median_centered = median_score - median(median_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    highest_subtype = comparison_group[which.max(median_score)],
    lowest_subtype = comparison_group[which.min(median_score)]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# 14D — Visualization 1: Faceted boxplot
# ----------------------------

p_box_pam50 <- ggplot(
  pam50_w,
  aes(x = comparison_group, y = score, fill = comparison_group)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.75,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.12,
    size = 0.45
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~axis, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Ferroptosis axis activity across PAM50 breast cancer subtypes",
    subtitle = "Primary weighted module scores using conservative core ferroptosis axes",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Weighted ferroptosis axis score"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14E — Visualization 2: Heatmap-like median pattern plot
# ----------------------------

p_heat_pam50 <- ggplot(
  pam50_axis_pattern,
  aes(x = comparison_group, y = axis, fill = axis_median_centered)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", median_score)), size = 3.2) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(pam50_w$axis))) +
  labs(
    title = "Median ferroptosis axis pattern by PAM50 subtype",
    subtitle = "Cell values show median weighted axis score; fill is centered within each axis",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Centered\nmedian"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14F — Save tables and figures
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  kw_pam50,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_PAM50_weighted_axis_KruskalWallis.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  pairwise_pam50,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_PAM50_weighted_axis_pairwise_Wilcoxon.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  pam50_axis_pattern,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_PAM50_weighted_axis_median_pattern.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "14_PAM50_weighted_axis_boxplots.png"),
  p_box_pam50,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "14_PAM50_weighted_axis_median_heatmap.png"),
  p_heat_pam50,
  width = 10,
  height = 5.8,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

message("PAM50 weighted axis comparison completed.")
message("Saved figures:")
message("- 14_PAM50_weighted_axis_boxplots.png")
message("- 14_PAM50_weighted_axis_median_heatmap.png")

print(kw_pam50)
p_box_pam50
p_heat_pam50

```
This chunk indicate that TNBC tumors exhibit a ferroptosis-prone state characterized by coordinated activation of PUFA loading, mitochondrial and lipid peroxidation pathways, whereas ER+ tumors exhibit a ferroptosis-buffering state driven by GPX4-dependent and alternative antioxidant systems.

```{r Chunk 15 — ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis signature}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 15 — ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis signature
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Define focused ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis axis signature.
#   Uses:
#     - Wilcoxon test
#     - BH-FDR
#     - Cliff's delta computed manually
#     - Forest plot visualization
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})

scores_long_all <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_long_all.rds"))

focused_w <- scores_long_all %>%
  filter(
    cohort == "Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
    score_type == "weighted_primary",
    comparison_group %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC"),
    is.finite(score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_group = factor(comparison_group, levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC"))
  )

stopifnot(all(c("ERpos", "TNBC") %in% focused_w$comparison_group))

# ----------------------------
# 15A — Safe manual Cliff's delta
# Positive value = higher score in TNBC than ERpos
# ----------------------------

cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos <- function(x_er, x_tn) {
  x_er <- x_er[is.finite(x_er)]
  x_tn <- x_tn[is.finite(x_tn)]

  if (length(x_er) < 5 || length(x_tn) < 5) return(NA_real_)

  diff_mat <- outer(x_tn, x_er, FUN = "-")

  delta <- (sum(diff_mat > 0) - sum(diff_mat < 0)) /
    (length(x_tn) * length(x_er))

  as.numeric(delta)
}

# ----------------------------
# 15B — Wilcoxon + FDR + effect size
# ----------------------------

signature_table <- focused_w %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos = sum(comparison_group == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC  = sum(comparison_group == "TNBC"),

    median_ERpos = median(score[comparison_group == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC  = median(score[comparison_group == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_ERpos = mean(score[comparison_group == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_TNBC  = mean(score[comparison_group == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),

    delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,

    cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos = cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos(
      score[comparison_group == "ERpos"],
      score[comparison_group == "TNBC"]
    ),

    p_value = suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(score ~ comparison_group)$p.value
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos > 0 ~ "TNBC higher",
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos < 0 ~ "ERpos higher",
      TRUE ~ "No shift"
    ),
    signature_support = case_when(
      FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos) >= 0.20 ~ "Strong",
      FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos) >= 0.10 ~ "Moderate",
      FDR_BH < 0.05 ~ "Statistical_only",
      TRUE ~ "Not_significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR_BH)

# ----------------------------
# 15C — Forest plot
# ----------------------------

plot_tbl <- signature_table %>%
  mutate(
    axis = factor(axis, levels = rev(axis))
  )

p_forest <- ggplot(
  plot_tbl,
  aes(x = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, y = axis)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, y = axis, yend = axis),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = signature_support), size = 3.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Focused ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis axis signature",
    subtitle = "Cliff's delta from weighted axis scores; positive values indicate higher TNBC activity",
    x = "Cliff's delta (TNBC vs ERpos)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Evidence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 15D — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  signature_table,
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_ERpos_TNBC_weighted_axis_signature.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "15_ERpos_TNBC_weighted_axis_forest.png"),
  p_forest,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Focused ERpos vs TNBC axis signature completed.")
print(signature_table)

p_forest

```
Downsampling analysis demonstrated that the TNBC-associated increase in PUFA loading, mitochondrial ferroptosis defense (DHODH axis), and lipid peroxidation capacity remained highly consistent across 500 resampling iterations, confirming that these signals are not driven by the large ERpos sample size. In contrast, alternative antioxidant pathways (FSP1-CoQ and BH4) showed weak and unstable differences, indicating that they do not contribute robustly to subtype separation.
 
Results:
TNBC = ferroptosis-primed state

Driven by:

PUFA loading ↑
Lipid peroxidation ↑
Mitochondrial DHODH axis ↑
ERpos = ferroptosis-buffered state

Driven by:

GPX4–selenium system ↑ (VERY robust)

```{r Chunk 16 — Downsampling robustness for ERpos vs TNBC signature}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 16 — Downsampling robustness for ERpos vs TNBC signature
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → robustness → wiring → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Address ERpos/TNBC imbalance by repeatedly downsampling ERpos to TNBC size.
#   Robust axes should keep the same direction and remain significant frequently.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(SPEC$seed)

scores_long_all <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_long_all.rds"))

focused_w <- scores_long_all %>%
  filter(
    cohort == "Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
    score_type == "weighted_primary",
    comparison_group %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC"),
    is.finite(score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_group = factor(comparison_group, levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC"))
  )

axis_names <- levels(focused_w$axis)

n_er <- sum(focused_w$comparison_group == "ERpos") / length(axis_names)
n_tn <- sum(focused_w$comparison_group == "TNBC") / length(axis_names)

B_down <- SPEC$B_downsample

cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos <- function(x_er, x_tn) {
  x_er <- x_er[is.finite(x_er)]
  x_tn <- x_tn[is.finite(x_tn)]
  if (length(x_er) < 5 || length(x_tn) < 5) return(NA_real_)

  diff_mat <- outer(x_tn, x_er, FUN = "-")
  (sum(diff_mat > 0) - sum(diff_mat < 0)) / (length(x_tn) * length(x_er))
}

run_one_downsample <- function(b) {

  er_ids <- focused_w %>%
    filter(comparison_group == "ERpos") %>%
    distinct(sample_id) %>%
    pull(sample_id)

  tn_ids <- focused_w %>%
    filter(comparison_group == "TNBC") %>%
    distinct(sample_id) %>%
    pull(sample_id)

  er_keep <- sample(er_ids, size = length(tn_ids), replace = FALSE)

  dat_b <- focused_w %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% c(er_keep, tn_ids))

  dat_b %>%
    group_by(axis) %>%
    summarise(
      iter = b,
      n_ERpos = sum(comparison_group == "ERpos"),
      n_TNBC = sum(comparison_group == "TNBC"),
      median_ERpos = median(score[comparison_group == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_TNBC = median(score[comparison_group == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos = cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos(
        score[comparison_group == "ERpos"],
        score[comparison_group == "TNBC"]
      ),
      p_value = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(score ~ comparison_group)$p.value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

downsample_results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(B_down), run_one_downsample)) %>%
  group_by(iter) %>%
  mutate(FDR_BH_iter = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

downsample_summary <- downsample_results %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    B = n(),
    median_cliffs_delta = median(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo95_cliffs_delta = quantile(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi95_cliffs_delta = quantile(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_delta_median = median(delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos, na.rm = TRUE),
    direction_TNBC_higher_freq = mean(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    direction_ERpos_higher_freq = mean(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    FDR_lt_0.05_freq = mean(FDR_BH_iter < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    robust_direction = case_when(
      direction_TNBC_higher_freq >= 0.80 ~ "TNBC_higher_robust",
      direction_ERpos_higher_freq >= 0.80 ~ "ERpos_higher_robust",
      TRUE ~ "Direction_unstable"
    ),
    robustness_class = case_when(
      FDR_lt_0.05_freq >= 0.80 &
        (direction_TNBC_higher_freq >= 0.80 | direction_ERpos_higher_freq >= 0.80) ~ "Strong",
      FDR_lt_0.05_freq >= 0.50 &
        (direction_TNBC_higher_freq >= 0.70 | direction_ERpos_higher_freq >= 0.70) ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ "Weak"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median_cliffs_delta)))

p_down <- ggplot(
  downsample_summary,
  aes(x = median_cliffs_delta, y = reorder(axis, median_cliffs_delta))
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lo95_cliffs_delta, xmax = hi95_cliffs_delta),
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = robustness_class), size = 3.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Downsampling robustness of ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis signature",
    subtitle = paste0("ERpos repeatedly downsampled to TNBC size; B = ", B_down),
    x = "Median Cliff's delta across downsampling runs",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Robustness"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

readr::write_csv(
  downsample_results,
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_downsampling_ERpos_to_TNBC_all_iterations.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  downsample_summary,
```

```{r Chunk 17 — Weighted vs unweighted consistency check}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 17 — Weighted vs unweighted consistency check
# Purpose:
#   Confirm that ERpos/TNBC signature is not an artifact of weighted scoring.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})

scores_long_all <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_long_all.rds"))

focused_both <- scores_long_all %>%
  filter(
    cohort == "Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
    score_type %in% c("weighted_primary", "unweighted_sensitivity"),
    comparison_group %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC"),
    is.finite(score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_group = factor(comparison_group, levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC"))
  )

cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos <- function(x_er, x_tn) {
  x_er <- x_er[is.finite(x_er)]
  x_tn <- x_tn[is.finite(x_tn)]
  if (length(x_er) < 5 || length(x_tn) < 5) return(NA_real_)

  diff_mat <- outer(x_tn, x_er, FUN = "-")
  (sum(diff_mat > 0) - sum(diff_mat < 0)) / (length(x_tn) * length(x_er))
}

consistency_table <- focused_both %>%
  group_by(score_type, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos = sum(comparison_group == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC = sum(comparison_group == "TNBC"),
    median_ERpos = median(score[comparison_group == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC = median(score[comparison_group == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,
    cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos = cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos(
      score[comparison_group == "ERpos"],
      score[comparison_group == "TNBC"]
    ),
    p_value = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(score ~ comparison_group)$p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(score_type) %>%
  mutate(FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos > 0 ~ "TNBC_higher",
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos < 0 ~ "ERpos_higher",
      TRUE ~ "No_shift"
    )
  )

consistency_wide <- consistency_table %>%
  select(score_type, axis, cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, FDR_BH, direction) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = score_type,
    values_from = c(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, FDR_BH, direction)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    same_direction =
      direction_weighted_primary == direction_unweighted_sensitivity,
    consistent_signature =
      same_direction &
      FDR_BH_weighted_primary < 0.05 &
      FDR_BH_unweighted_sensitivity < 0.05
  )

p_consistency <- ggplot(
  consistency_table,
  aes(x = axis, y = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, fill = score_type)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Weighted vs unweighted consistency of ERpos/TNBC axis signature",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate higher TNBC activity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cliff's delta (TNBC vs ERpos)",
    fill = "Score type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

readr::write_csv(
  consistency_table,
  file.path(paths$tables, "17_weighted_unweighted_ERpos_TNBC_signature.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  consistency_wide,
  file.path(paths$tables, "17_weighted_unweighted_consistency_summary.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "17_weighted_unweighted_ERpos_TNBC_consistency.png"),
  p_consistency,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Weighted/unweighted consistency check completed.")
print(consistency_wide)
p_consistency
```

```{r Chunk 18 — ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis wiring}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 18 — ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis wiring
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → robustness → wiring → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Test whether ferroptosis axes are coordinated differently in ERpos vs TNBC.
#   This is the key novelty layer: not only abundance, but regulatory wiring.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

scores_w_focused <- readRDS(
  file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_annotated.rds")
)

axis_names <- names(readRDS(
  file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds")
))

stopifnot(all(axis_names %in% names(scores_w_focused)))

# ----------------------------
# 18A — Split scores by group
# ----------------------------

scores_ERpos <- scores_w_focused %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos") %>%
  select(all_of(axis_names))

scores_TNBC <- scores_w_focused %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC") %>%
  select(all_of(axis_names))

message("ERpos samples for wiring: ", nrow(scores_ERpos))
message("TNBC samples for wiring: ", nrow(scores_TNBC))

stopifnot(nrow(scores_ERpos) > 100)
stopifnot(nrow(scores_TNBC) > 50)

# ----------------------------
# 18B — Spearman correlation matrices
# ----------------------------

cor_ERpos <- cor(scores_ERpos, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_TNBC  <- cor(scores_TNBC,  method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_diff <- cor_TNBC - cor_ERpos

# ----------------------------
# 18C — Long edge table
# ----------------------------

make_edge_table <- function(cor_mat, group_label) {
  out <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, rho = Freq) %>%
    filter(as.character(axis_1) < as.character(axis_2)) %>%
    mutate(group = group_label)

  out
}

edges_ERpos <- make_edge_table(cor_ERpos, "ERpos")
edges_TNBC  <- make_edge_table(cor_TNBC,  "TNBC")

edges_diff <- edges_ERpos %>%
  select(axis_1, axis_2, rho_ERpos = rho) %>%
  left_join(
    edges_TNBC %>% select(axis_1, axis_2, rho_TNBC = rho),
    by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos = rho_TNBC - rho_ERpos,
    abs_delta_rho = abs(delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos),
    edge_class = case_when(
      abs_delta_rho >= 0.30 ~ "Large rewiring",
      abs_delta_rho >= 0.20 ~ "Moderate rewiring",
      abs_delta_rho >= 0.10 ~ "Small rewiring",
      TRUE ~ "Minimal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_delta_rho))

# ----------------------------
# 18D — Heatmap plotting function
# ----------------------------

plot_cor_heatmap <- function(cor_mat, title, fill_title = "Spearman\nrho") {

  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, value = Freq) %>%
    mutate(
      axis_1 = factor(axis_1, levels = axis_names),
      axis_2 = factor(axis_2, levels = rev(axis_names))
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = axis_1, y = axis_2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      name = fill_title
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

plot_diff_heatmap <- function(diff_mat) {

  max_abs <- max(abs(diff_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(diff_mat)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, value = Freq) %>%
    mutate(
      axis_1 = factor(axis_1, levels = axis_names),
      axis_2 = factor(axis_2, levels = rev(axis_names))
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = axis_1, y = axis_2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
      name = "Delta rho\nTNBC-ERpos"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Differential ferroptosis wiring",
      subtitle = "Positive values indicate stronger axis coupling in TNBC",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

p_cor_ERpos <- plot_cor_heatmap(cor_ERpos, "ERpos ferroptosis wiring")
p_cor_TNBC  <- plot_cor_heatmap(cor_TNBC,  "TNBC ferroptosis wiring")
p_cor_diff  <- plot_diff_heatmap(cor_diff)

# ----------------------------
# 18E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(cor_ERpos, file.path(paths$processed, "18_cor_axis_wiring_ERpos.rds"))
saveRDS(cor_TNBC,  file.path(paths$processed, "18_cor_axis_wiring_TNBC.rds"))
saveRDS(cor_diff,  file.path(paths$processed, "18_cor_axis_wiring_diff_TNBC_minus_ERpos.rds"))

readr::write_csv(edges_ERpos, file.path(paths$tables, "18_edges_axis_wiring_ERpos.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_TNBC,  file.path(paths$tables, "18_edges_axis_wiring_TNBC.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_diff,  file.path(paths$tables, "18_edges_differential_wiring_TNBC_minus_ERpos.csv"))

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "18_axis_wiring_ERpos_heatmap.png"),
  p_cor_ERpos,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "18_axis_wiring_TNBC_heatmap.png"),
  p_cor_TNBC,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "18_axis_wiring_diff_TNBC_minus_ERpos_heatmap.png"),
  p_cor_diff,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Ferroptosis wiring completed.")
message("Top differential wiring edges:")
print(head(edges_diff, 10))

p_cor_ERpos
p_cor_TNBC
p_cor_diff
```
