```{r Chunk 19 — Permutation test for differential ferroptosis wiring}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 19 — Permutation test for differential ferroptosis wiring
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → robustness → wiring → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Test whether ERpos vs TNBC wiring differences are larger than expected by chance.
#
# Null hypothesis:
#   Group labels are exchangeable; observed TNBC-ERpos delta rho is random.
#
# Output:
#   - observed edge-level delta rho
#   - empirical permutation p value
#   - BH-FDR
#   - clean significant-edge table
#   - volcano-style rewiring plot
#   - significant differential-wiring heatmap
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(SPEC$seed)

# ----------------------------
# 19A — Load focused weighted scores
# ----------------------------

scores_w_focused <- readRDS(
  file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_annotated.rds")
)

axis_names <- names(readRDS(
  file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds")
))

B_perm <- SPEC$B_perm

wiring_df <- scores_w_focused %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, all_of(axis_names)) %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

stopifnot(all(axis_names %in% names(wiring_df)))
stopifnot(all(c("ERpos", "TNBC") %in% wiring_df$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC))

n_ERpos <- sum(wiring_df$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos")
n_TNBC  <- sum(wiring_df$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC")

message("Permutation wiring test:")
message("ERpos n = ", n_ERpos)
message("TNBC n  = ", n_TNBC)
message("B_perm  = ", B_perm)

# ----------------------------
# 19B — Helper functions
# ----------------------------

get_delta_edges <- function(dat, group_col = "focused_group_ERpos_TNBC") {

  mat_ER <- dat %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] == "ERpos") %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(axis_names))

  mat_TN <- dat %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] == "TNBC") %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(axis_names))

  cor_ER <- cor(mat_ER, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cor_TN <- cor(mat_TN, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  out <- expand.grid(
    axis_1 = axis_names,
    axis_2 = axis_names,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(axis_1 < axis_2) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      rho_ERpos = cor_ER[axis_1, axis_2],
      rho_TNBC  = cor_TN[axis_1, axis_2],
      delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos = rho_TNBC - rho_ERpos
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  out
}

observed_edges <- get_delta_edges(wiring_df)

# ----------------------------
# 19C — Permutation loop
# ----------------------------

perm_delta_mat <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(observed_edges),
  ncol = B_perm
)

rownames(perm_delta_mat) <- paste(observed_edges$axis_1, observed_edges$axis_2, sep = "__")

for (b in seq_len(B_perm)) {

  dat_perm <- wiring_df
  dat_perm$perm_group <- sample(dat_perm$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)

  perm_edges <- get_delta_edges(dat_perm, group_col = "perm_group")

  perm_delta_mat[, b] <- perm_edges$delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos

  if (b %% 100 == 0) {
    message("Completed permutation ", b, " / ", B_perm)
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# 19D — Empirical two-sided p values + FDR
# ----------------------------

perm_p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(observed_edges)), function(i) {

  obs <- abs(observed_edges$delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos[i])
  null <- abs(perm_delta_mat[i, ])

  # +1 correction avoids p = 0
  (sum(null >= obs, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (sum(is.finite(null)) + 1)

}, numeric(1))

perm_summary <- observed_edges %>%
  mutate(
    p_perm = perm_p,
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_perm, method = "BH"),
    abs_delta_rho = abs(delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos),
    direction = case_when(
      delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos > 0 ~ "Stronger in TNBC",
      delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos < 0 ~ "Stronger in ERpos",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    evidence_class = case_when(
      FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs_delta_rho >= 0.30 ~ "Strong rewiring",
      FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs_delta_rho >= 0.20 ~ "Moderate rewiring",
      FDR_BH < 0.10 & abs_delta_rho >= 0.20 ~ "Nominal rewiring",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR_BH, desc(abs_delta_rho))

sig_edges <- perm_summary %>%
  filter(FDR_BH < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_delta_rho))

# ----------------------------
# 19E — Plot 1: differential-wiring volcano
# ----------------------------

p_volcano <- ggplot(
  perm_summary,
  aes(
    x = delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos,
    y = -log10(p_perm),
    label = paste(axis_1, axis_2, sep = "–")
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = evidence_class), size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = perm_summary %>%
      filter(FDR_BH < 0.10 | abs_delta_rho >= 0.30),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permutation-tested differential ferroptosis wiring",
    subtitle = paste0("Empirical two-sided permutation test; B = ", B_perm),
    x = expression(Delta*rho~"(TNBC - ERpos)"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(permutation p value)"),
    shape = "Evidence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 19F — Plot 2: FDR-filtered differential-wiring heatmap
# ----------------------------

sig_mat <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(axis_names),
  ncol = length(axis_names),
  dimnames = list(axis_names, axis_names)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(perm_summary))) {
  a1 <- perm_summary$axis_1[i]
  a2 <- perm_summary$axis_2[i]

  if (perm_summary$FDR_BH[i] < 0.05) {
    sig_mat[a1, a2] <- perm_summary$delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos[i]
    sig_mat[a2, a1] <- perm_summary$delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos[i]
  }
}

diag(sig_mat) <- 0

max_abs_sig <- max(abs(sig_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(max_abs_sig) || max_abs_sig == 0) max_abs_sig <- 0.5

sig_heat_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(sig_mat)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, delta_rho = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    axis_1 = factor(axis_1, levels = axis_names),
    axis_2 = factor(axis_2, levels = rev(axis_names)),
    label = ifelse(is.na(delta_rho), "", sprintf("%.2f", delta_rho))
  )

p_sig_heat <- ggplot(sig_heat_df, aes(x = axis_1, y = axis_2, fill = delta_rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs_sig, max_abs_sig),
    na.value = "grey92",
    name = "Significant\nDelta rho"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "FDR-significant differential ferroptosis wiring",
    subtitle = "Only edges with BH-FDR < 0.05 are shown",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 19G — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(
  perm_delta_mat,
  file.path(paths$processed, "19_permutation_null_delta_rho_matrix.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  perm_summary,
  file.path(paths$processed, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_summary.rds")
)

readr::write_csv(
  perm_summary,
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_all_edges.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  sig_edges,
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_FDR_significant_edges.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_volcano.png"),
  p_volcano,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_FDR_heatmap.png"),
  p_sig_heat,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "Chunk 19 permutation differential wiring test",
    "",
    paste0("ERpos n = ", n_ERpos),
    paste0("TNBC n = ", n_TNBC),
    paste0("Permutation iterations = ", B_perm),
    "",
    "Test:",
    "For each ferroptosis axis pair, group labels were permuted and the TNBC-minus-ERpos Spearman correlation difference was recomputed.",
    "Empirical two-sided p values were calculated from the null distribution of absolute delta rho.",
    "BH-FDR was applied across all tested axis pairs.",
    "",
    "Interpretation:",
    "Significant positive delta rho indicates stronger axis coupling in TNBC.",
    "Significant negative delta rho indicates stronger axis coupling in ERpos."
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_note.txt")
)

message("Permutation differential wiring test completed.")
message("Significant edges at FDR < 0.05: ", nrow(sig_edges))
print(sig_edges)

p_volcano
p_sig_heat
```
The BIG biological conclusion 

we can now state:

 ERpos tumors:

Maintain a modular, buffered ferroptosis defense network, where antioxidant pathways are strongly interconnected but largely insulated from lipid and iron metabolism.

TNBC tumors:

Exhibit a rewired ferroptosis network, where antioxidant systems (GPX4, FSP1, BH4, DHODH) are directly coupled to ferroptosis-driving processes (PUFA loading, iron handling), forming a tightly integrated but potentially vulnerable state.

```{r Chunk 20 — ERpos vs TNBC wiring network visualization}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 20 — ERpos vs TNBC wiring network visualization
# Purpose:
#   Draw clean R/igraph network plots for ERpos and TNBC ferroptosis wiring.
#   Fixes:
#     - no truncated labels
#     - larger circular layout
#     - cleaner legends
#     - white background
#     - publication-ready PNGs
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
})

if (!requireNamespace("ggraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggraph")
  library(ggraph)
}

axis_names <- names(readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds")))

cor_ERpos <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "18_cor_axis_wiring_ERpos.rds"))
cor_TNBC  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "18_cor_axis_wiring_TNBC.rds"))

sig_edges <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_FDR_significant_edges.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# 20A — Labels and node classes
# ----------------------------

label_map <- c(
  "Xc_GSH" = "Xc/GSH",
  "GPX4_Selenium" = "GPX4/Se",
  "FSP1_CoQ" = "FSP1/CoQ",
  "BH4_GCH1" = "BH4/GCH1",
  "DHODH_Mito" = "DHODH",
  "Iron_Handling" = "Iron",
  "PUFA_Loading" = "PUFA",
  "Lipid_Peroxidation" = "Lipid\nperox."
)

node_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  name = axis_names,
  label = dplyr::recode(name, !!!label_map),
  axis_class = case_when(
    name %in% c("Xc_GSH", "GPX4_Selenium", "FSP1_CoQ", "BH4_GCH1", "DHODH_Mito") ~ "Defense",
    name %in% c("Iron_Handling", "PUFA_Loading", "Lipid_Peroxidation") ~ "Susceptibility",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# 20B — Convert correlation matrix to edge table
# ----------------------------

make_network_edges <- function(cor_mat, group_label, thr = 0.25) {

  as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, rho = Freq) %>%
    mutate(
      from = as.character(from),
      to = as.character(to)
    ) %>%
    filter(from < to) %>%
    mutate(
      abs_rho = abs(rho),
      sign = ifelse(rho >= 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
      group = group_label
    ) %>%
    filter(abs_rho >= thr)
}

NETWORK_THR <- SPEC$thr_abs_r

edges_ERpos <- make_network_edges(cor_ERpos, "ERpos", thr = NETWORK_THR)
edges_TNBC  <- make_network_edges(cor_TNBC,  "TNBC",  thr = NETWORK_THR)

# ----------------------------
# 20C — Fixed larger circular layout
# ----------------------------

theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = length(axis_names) + 1)[-1]

layout_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  name = axis_names,
  x = 1.45 * cos(theta),
  y = 1.45 * sin(theta)
)

# ----------------------------
# 20D — Plot function
# ----------------------------

plot_axis_network <- function(edge_tbl, title_text, subtitle_text) {

  graph_obj <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = edge_tbl,
    vertices = node_tbl,
    directed = FALSE
  )

  layout_use <- layout_tbl %>%
    filter(name %in% igraph::V(graph_obj)$name) %>%
    arrange(match(name, igraph::V(graph_obj)$name)) %>%
    select(x, y) %>%
    as.matrix()

  ggraph(graph_obj, layout = "manual", x = layout_use[, 1], y = layout_use[, 2]) +
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(width = abs_rho, color = sign),
      alpha = 0.78,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      aes(fill = axis_class),
      shape = 21,
      size = 6.8,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = label),
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      box.padding = 0.65,
      point.padding = 0.45,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.45, 3.4),
      name = "|Spearman rho|"
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
      values = c("Positive" = "#B2182B", "Negative" = "#2166AC"),
      name = "Correlation"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Defense" = "#8DD3C7", "Susceptibility" = "#FDB462", "Other" = "grey80"),
      name = "Axis class"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      plot.margin = margin(25, 55, 25, 55)
    )
}

p_net_ERpos <- plot_axis_network(
  edges_ERpos,
  title_text = "ERpos ferroptosis wiring",
  subtitle_text = paste0("Edges shown if |rho| ≥ ", NETWORK_THR)
)

p_net_TNBC <- plot_axis_network(
  edges_TNBC,
  title_text = "TNBC ferroptosis wiring",
  subtitle_text = paste0("Edges shown if |rho| ≥ ", NETWORK_THR)
)

p_network_compare <- p_net_ERpos + p_net_TNBC +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Ferroptosis axis wiring differs between ERpos and TNBC",
    subtitle = "TNBC shows stronger coupling of defense axes with PUFA loading and iron handling",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 20E — Differential FDR-significant network
# ----------------------------

edges_diff_sig <- sig_edges %>%
  transmute(
    from = axis_1,
    to = axis_2,
    delta_rho = delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos,
    abs_delta = abs(delta_rho),
    sign = ifelse(delta_rho >= 0, "Stronger in TNBC", "Stronger in ERpos")
  )

graph_diff <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_diff_sig,
  vertices = node_tbl,
  directed = FALSE
)

layout_diff <- layout_tbl %>%
  filter(name %in% igraph::V(graph_diff)$name) %>%
  arrange(match(name, igraph::V(graph_diff)$name)) %>%
  select(x, y) %>%
  as.matrix()

p_diff_network <- ggraph(graph_diff, layout = "manual", x = layout_diff[, 1], y = layout_diff[, 2]) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = abs_delta, color = sign),
    alpha = 0.88,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(fill = axis_class),
    shape = 21,
    size = 7.2,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = label),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 4.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(
    range = c(0.8, 4.2),
    name = "|Delta rho|"
  ) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = c("Stronger in TNBC" = "#B2182B", "Stronger in ERpos" = "#2166AC"),
    name = "Differential wiring"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Defense" = "#8DD3C7", "Susceptibility" = "#FDB462", "Other" = "grey80"),
    name = "Axis class"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "FDR-significant differential ferroptosis wiring",
    subtitle = "Edges are BH-FDR < 0.05 from permutation testing"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    plot.margin = margin(30, 65, 30, 65)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 20F — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(edges_ERpos, file.path(paths$tables, "20_network_edges_ERpos_absrho_filtered.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_TNBC,  file.path(paths$tables, "20_network_edges_TNBC_absrho_filtered.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_diff_sig, file.path(paths$tables, "20_network_edges_differential_FDR_significant.csv"))

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "20_network_ERpos_vs_TNBC_side_by_side.png"),
  p_network_compare,
  width = 17,
  height = 8.5,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "20_network_differential_FDR_significant.png"),
  p_diff_network,
  width = 9,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Network visualization completed.")
message("Saved:")
message("- 20_network_ERpos_vs_TNBC_side_by_side.png")
message("- 20_network_differential_FDR_significant.png")

# ----------------------------
# 20G — Safe inline display with fallback
# ----------------------------

# Always save to file first (already done above).
# Attempt inline render with graceful fallback to individual plots.

safe_print_patchwork <- function(combined_plot, fallback_list, label) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      print(combined_plot)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        label,
        ": patchwork render failed (Plots pane may be too small). ",
        "Showing individual plots instead. See saved PNG for the combined version."
      )
      for (p in fallback_list) {
        tryCatch(print(p), error = function(e2) message("Individual plot also failed to render inline."))
      }
    }
  )
}

safe_print_patchwork(
  combined_plot  = p_network_compare,
  fallback_list  = list(p_net_ERpos, p_net_TNBC),
  label          = "Network side-by-side"
)

# Differential network is a single plot — safe to print directly
tryCatch(
  print(p_diff_network),
  error = function(e) {
    message("p_diff_network render failed inline. See saved PNG.")
  }
)
```

```{r Chunk 21 — Automated unbiased validation marker selection}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 21 — Automated unbiased validation marker selection
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Force dplyr::select to win over any masked versions (e.g., from MASS via effectsize)
select <- dplyr::select

# ----------------------------
# 21A — Load inputs
# ----------------------------

expr_z <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
clin   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

axis_gene_table <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_membership.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

axis_signature <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_ERpos_TNBC_weighted_axis_signature.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

downsample_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_downsampling_ERpos_to_TNBC_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

consistency_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "17_weighted_unweighted_consistency_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diff_wiring <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_all_edges.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_z) == clin$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 21B — Manual Cliff's delta
# ----------------------------

cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos <- function(x_er, x_tn) {
  x_er <- x_er[is.finite(x_er)]
  x_tn <- x_tn[is.finite(x_tn)]
  if (length(x_er) < 5 || length(x_tn) < 5) return(NA_real_)
  diff_mat <- outer(x_tn, x_er, FUN = "-")
  (sum(diff_mat > 0) - sum(diff_mat < 0)) / (length(x_tn) * length(x_er))
}

# ----------------------------
# 21C — Axis-level evidence score
# ----------------------------

axis_evidence <- axis_signature %>%
  dplyr::select(
    axis,
    axis_FDR_BH        = FDR_BH,
    axis_cliffs_delta  = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos,
    axis_direction     = direction,
    signature_support
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    downsample_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(
        axis,
        robustness_class,
        FDR_lt_0.05_freq,
        direction_TNBC_higher_freq,
        direction_ERpos_higher_freq
      ),
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    consistency_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(axis, same_direction, consistent_signature),
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    axis_difference_points = case_when(
      axis_FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(axis_cliffs_delta) >= 0.20 ~ 2,
      axis_FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(axis_cliffs_delta) >= 0.10 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    axis_robustness_points = case_when(
      robustness_class == "Strong"   ~ 2,
      robustness_class == "Moderate" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    axis_consistency_points = case_when(
      same_direction == TRUE ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 21D — Wiring support per axis
# ----------------------------

wiring_axis_support <- diff_wiring %>%
  filter(FDR_BH < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(axis_1, axis_2, delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos, FDR_BH) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(axis_1, axis_2),
    names_to  = "axis_position",
    values_to = "axis"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges = n(),
    max_abs_delta_rho = max(abs(delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos), na.rm = TRUE),
    wiring_points = case_when(
      n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges >= 3 ~ 2,
      n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges >= 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 21E — Gene-level expression statistics for core genes PRESENT in expr_z
# ----------------------------

core_genes <- axis_gene_table %>%
  distinct(axis, gene) %>%
  filter(gene %in% rownames(expr_z))

message("Core genes defined: ", nrow(axis_gene_table %>% distinct(gene)))
message("Core genes present in expr_z: ", nrow(core_genes))

if (nrow(core_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Zero core ferroptosis genes found in expr_z. ",
    "The expression matrix is likely truncated (check Chunk 03 fread fill=TRUE). ",
    "Available rownames sample: ",
    paste(head(rownames(expr_z), 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

expr_core <- expr_z[core_genes$gene, , drop = FALSE]

gene_df         <- as.data.frame(t(expr_core))
gene_df$sample_id <- rownames(gene_df)

gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  left_join(
    clin %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC")) %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

gene_long <- gene_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(core_genes$gene),
    names_to  = "gene",
    values_to = "z_expression"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(z_expression))

gene_stats <- gene_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos  = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC   = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"),
    median_ERpos = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC  = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos      = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,
    gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos    = cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos(
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"],
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"]
    ),
    gene_p_value = suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(z_expression ~ focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)$p.value
    ),
    pct_finite = mean(is.finite(z_expression)) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_FDR_BH = p.adjust(gene_p_value, method = "BH"),
    gene_direction = case_when(
      gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos > 0 ~ "TNBC higher",
      gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos < 0 ~ "ERpos higher",
      TRUE ~ "No shift"
    ),
    gene_expression_points = case_when(
      gene_FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos) >= 0.30 ~ 3,
      gene_FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos) >= 0.20 ~ 2,
      gene_FDR_BH < 0.05 & abs(gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos) >= 0.10 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 21F — Automated marker ranking
# ----------------------------

marker_ranking <- core_genes %>%
  left_join(axis_evidence,       by = "axis") %>%
  left_join(wiring_axis_support, by = "axis") %>%
  left_join(gene_stats,          by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges = replace_na(n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges, 0),
    max_abs_delta_rho              = replace_na(max_abs_delta_rho, 0),
    wiring_points                  = replace_na(wiring_points, 0),
    detectability_points = case_when(pct_finite >= 95 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    total_marker_score =
      axis_difference_points +
      axis_robustness_points +
      axis_consistency_points +
      wiring_points +
      gene_expression_points +
      detectability_points,
    selection_reason = paste0(
      "Axis=", axis,
      "; axis_delta=", round(axis_cliffs_delta, 2),
      "; gene_delta=", round(gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, 2),
      "; wiring_edges=", n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_marker_score), gene_FDR_BH, desc(abs(gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos)))

# ----------------------------
# 21G — Choose final unbiased validation panel
# ----------------------------

eligible_axes <- axis_evidence %>%
  left_join(wiring_axis_support, by = "axis") %>%
  mutate(
    n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges = replace_na(n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges, 0),
    axis_total_support =
      axis_difference_points +
      axis_robustness_points +
      axis_consistency_points +
      replace_na(wiring_points, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(axis_total_support >= 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(axis_total_support), axis_FDR_BH)

selected_panel <- marker_ranking %>%
  semi_join(eligible_axes, by = "axis") %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_marker_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(total_marker_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_for_validation = TRUE,
    validation_tier = case_when(
      row_number() <= 4 ~ "Minimal pilot panel",
      TRUE              ~ "Optional fifth marker"
    )
  )

# If eligible_axes filter is too strict and leaves no markers, fall back
if (nrow(selected_panel) == 0) {
  warning(
    "No markers passed eligible_axes filter (axis_total_support >= 3). ",
    "Falling back to top 5 markers from overall ranking."
  )
  selected_panel <- marker_ranking %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    mutate(
      selected_for_validation = TRUE,
      validation_tier = case_when(
        row_number() <= 4 ~ "Minimal pilot panel",
        TRUE              ~ "Optional fifth marker"
      )
    )
}

message("Selected panel (", nrow(selected_panel), " markers):")
message("All selected genes present in expr_z: ",
        all(selected_panel$gene %in% rownames(expr_z)))

# ----------------------------
# 21H — Visualization
# ----------------------------

n_plot <- min(20, nrow(marker_ranking))

p_marker_rank <- marker_ranking %>%
  mutate(
    gene_axis = paste0(gene, " / ", axis),
    selected  = gene %in% selected_panel$gene
  ) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_marker_score, n = n_plot) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(gene_axis, total_marker_score), y = total_marker_score)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = selected), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey75", "TRUE" = "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Automated ranking of candidate validation markers",
    subtitle = "Markers ranked by axis robustness, wiring support, and gene-level subtype evidence",
    x    = NULL,
    y    = "Automated marker score",
    fill = "Selected"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 21I — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  marker_ranking,
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_unbiased_marker_ranking_all_core_genes.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  selected_panel,
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_unbiased_selected_validation_panel.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "21_unbiased_marker_ranking.png"),
  p_marker_rank,
  width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 450, bg = "white"
)

message("Automated unbiased selected validation panel:")
print(selected_panel %>% dplyr::select(
  gene, axis, total_marker_score,
  gene_cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, gene_FDR_BH, validation_tier
))

p_marker_rank
```

```{r Chunk 22 — Boxplots of automatically selected validation markers}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 22 — Boxplots of automatically selected validation markers
# Purpose:
#   Plot patient-level expression for markers selected by Chunk 21.
#   No predefined marker list is used.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ----------------------------
# 22A — Load data
# ----------------------------

expr_z <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
clin   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

selected_panel <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_unbiased_selected_validation_panel.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

markers <- selected_panel$gene

missing_markers <- setdiff(markers, rownames(expr_z))
if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
  stop("Missing selected markers in expression matrix: ", paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_z) == clin$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 22B — Prepare expression table
# ----------------------------

df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_z[markers, , drop = FALSE]))
df$sample_id <- rownames(df)

df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    clin %>% select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC")) %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(markers),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "z_expression"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(z_expression)) %>%
  left_join(
    selected_panel %>% select(gene, axis, validation_tier),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = markers),
    gene_label = paste0(gene, "\n", axis)
  )

n_table <- df_long %>%
  distinct(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC) %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n")

n_ERpos <- n_table$n[n_table$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
n_TNBC  <- n_table$n[n_table$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"]

# ----------------------------
# 22C — Manual Cliff's delta
# Positive = higher in TNBC
# ----------------------------

cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos <- function(x_er, x_tn) {
  x_er <- x_er[is.finite(x_er)]
  x_tn <- x_tn[is.finite(x_tn)]

  if (length(x_er) < 5 || length(x_tn) < 5) return(NA_real_)

  diff_mat <- outer(x_tn, x_er, FUN = "-")

  (sum(diff_mat > 0) - sum(diff_mat < 0)) /
    (length(x_tn) * length(x_er))
}

# ----------------------------
# 22D — Gene-level stats
# ----------------------------

stats_wilcox <- df_long %>%
  group_by(gene, gene_label, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC  = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"),

    median_ERpos = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC  = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),

    delta_median_TNBC_minus_ERpos = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,

    cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos = cliffs_delta_tnbc_vs_erpos(
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"],
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"]
    ),

    p_value = suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(z_expression ~ focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)$p.value
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos > 0 ~ "TNBC higher",
      cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos < 0 ~ "ERpos higher",
      TRUE ~ "No shift"
    ),
    label = paste0(
      "FDR=", signif(FDR_BH, 2),
      "\nΔ=", round(cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos, 2)
    )
  )

y_pos <- df_long %>%
  group_by(gene, gene_label) %>%
  summarise(
    y.position = max(z_expression, na.rm = TRUE) +
      0.12 * diff(range(z_expression, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stats_plot <- stats_wilcox %>%
  left_join(y_pos, by = c("gene", "gene_label"))

# ----------------------------
# 22E — Plot without stat_pvalue_manual dependency
# ----------------------------

p_marker_box <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(x = focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, y = z_expression, fill = focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.85,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = stats_plot,
    aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y.position, yend = y.position),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = stats_plot,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = y.position, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~gene_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("ERpos" = "#E64B35", "TNBC" = "#4DBBD5")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of automatically selected ferroptosis validation markers",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Markers selected by unbiased axis-first ranking; ERpos (n=", n_ERpos,
      ") vs TNBC (n=", n_TNBC,
      "); Δ = Cliff's delta, positive values indicate higher TNBC expression"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Gene expression (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 22F — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  stats_wilcox,
  file.path(paths$tables, "22_unbiased_selected_marker_expression_statistics.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  df_long,
  file.path(paths$tables, "22_unbiased_selected_marker_expression_long.csv")
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "22_unbiased_selected_marker_expression_boxplots.png"),
  p_marker_box,
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Automatically selected markers plotted:")
print(stats_wilcox)

p_marker_box

```

TNBC shows a ferroptosis-pressure state with robust PUFA, lipid-peroxidation, and mitochondrial-axis activation, while ERpos shows stronger GPX4/Selenium buffering. Differential wiring indicates that TNBC couples ferroptosis-driving axes to antioxidant defense systems, suggesting a ferroptosis-prone but compensated/dependency state.

```{r Chunk 23 — Final discovery evidence summary}

# ----------------------------
# Chunk 23 — Final discovery evidence summary
# Pipeline:
#   Axis → robustness → wiring → marker → synthesis
#
# Purpose:
#   Integrate all discovery-level evidence into:
#     1) Unified axis summary table
#     2) Publication-ready synthesis plot
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ----------------------------
# 23A — Load inputs from previous chunks
# ----------------------------

axis_signature <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_ERpos_TNBC_weighted_axis_signature.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

downsample_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_downsampling_ERpos_to_TNBC_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

consistency_summary <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "17_weighted_unweighted_consistency_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wiring_edges <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_permutation_differential_wiring_all_edges.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

selected_panel <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_unbiased_selected_validation_panel.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

axes_order <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 23B — Wiring summary per axis
# ----------------------------

wiring_summary <- wiring_edges %>%
  filter(FDR_BH < 0.05) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(axis_1, axis_2),
    names_to = "axis_position",
    values_to = "axis"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig_edges = n(),
    max_abs_delta_rho = max(abs(delta_rho_TNBC_minus_ERpos), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 23C — Integrate all evidence
# ----------------------------

final_axis_summary <- axis_signature %>%
  select(
    axis,
    axis_FDR_BH = FDR_BH,
    axis_delta = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos,
    direction,
    signature_support
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    downsample_summary %>%
      select(
        axis,
        robustness_class,
        FDR_lt_0.05_freq,
        direction_TNBC_higher_freq
      ),
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    consistency_summary %>%
      select(axis, consistent_signature),
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    wiring_summary,
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_sig_edges = replace_na(n_sig_edges, 0),
    max_abs_delta_rho = replace_na(max_abs_delta_rho, 0),

    # classification for manuscript interpretation
    biological_role = case_when(
      axis_delta > 0 & robustness_class == "Strong" ~ "TNBC_ferroptosis_pressure",
      axis_delta < 0 & robustness_class == "Strong" ~ "ERpos_ferroptosis_buffering",
      TRUE ~ "Context_dependent"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(axis_FDR_BH) %>%
  mutate(
    axis = factor(axis, levels = axes_order)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 23D — Marker annotation per axis
# ----------------------------

axis_markers <- selected_panel %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    selected_markers = paste(gene, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

final_axis_summary <- final_axis_summary %>%
  left_join(axis_markers, by = "axis")

# ----------------------------
# 23E — Save summary table
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  final_axis_summary,
  file.path(paths$tables, "23_final_discovery_axis_summary.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 23F — Visualization (key synthesis plot)
# ----------------------------

p_summary <- ggplot(
  final_axis_summary,
  aes(x = axis_delta, y = axis)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = n_sig_edges,
      color = robustness_class
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = selected_markers),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(final_axis_summary$axis))) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Strong" = "#D73027",
      "Moderate" = "#FC8D59",
      "Weak" = "#91BFDB"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Integrated ferroptosis axis signature in breast cancer subtypes",
    subtitle = "Combining subtype difference, robustness, and differential wiring evidence",
    x = "Cliff's delta (TNBC vs ERpos)",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Significant wiring edges",
    color = "Robustness"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "23_final_discovery_axis_summary.png"),
  p_summary,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 500,
  bg = "white"
)

# ----------------------------
# 23G — Print outputs
# ----------------------------

message("Final discovery axis summary:")
print(final_axis_summary)

p_summary
```
